headline: HuyenBao v11.18 — confirm-before-buy + expanded collectibles + real photos + Power/Empire raised + explained
summary: Quality-of-life + content pass. (1) Purchase confirmation modal — clicking buy on a new or used item now opens a review dialog (photo + name + rarity + price + cash-after + upkeep + appreciate/depreciate rate + crew cost + used condition/age/story) with Confirm / Cancel buttons, so a stray click no longer commits the purchase. (2) Collectibles expanded — 10 new items across existing categories (Vacheron + Richard Mille watches, Harry Winston jewelry, Kiton suit, Bugatti Chiron hypercar) plus a new Collectibles category (rare gold coin, postage stamp, vintage wine case, Ming-dynasty vase, Stradivarius violin) with appreciating rates. (3) Real photos — 20 new item photos fetched via image-search (Omega/AP/Tag/Casio watches, Ferrari/BMW/Toyota cars, iPhone, Cartier/Tiffany jewelry, penthouse/villa/island properties, Azimut yacht, Cessna jet, Armani suit, KTM bike, goldcoin/stamp/wine for collectibles). ITEM_IMAGES grew from 10 → 30 entries; USED_IMAGES re-pointed at the new real photos (Toyota Camry → toyota.jpg, BMW M3 → bmw.jpg, Omega Speedmaster → omega.jpg, TAG Heuer Carrera → tag.jpg — instead of the old wrong-type fallbacks). (4) Power tier thresholds raised — mogul $10M→$15M, influencer $100M→$200M, national $1B→$2B, state_leader $10B→$30B; the climb to state_leader is now a true late-game stretch. (5) Entity tier thresholds raised — autonomous $50M→$75M / influence 50→60, nation $500M→$750M / 200→220, empire $5B→$7.5B / 500→550. (6) Power + Empire tabs now show explanation rows — a framed 'What does this tier mean?' blurb per tier (mogul / influencer / national / state) plus a scrutiny explanation and an Empire-tier explanation (conglomerate / autonomous / nation / empire / federation). All blurbs localised EN/VI/ZH. v11.18 hardening note also displayed. 4 Huyen-Hoc-AI features (Kinh Dịch / Tử Vi / Phong Thuỷ / Tarot) unchanged.
